text: Lindqvist Dairy said Tuesday it is recalling all batches of its oat yoghurt sold under the Meadow Pike and Northbank labels after routine testing found possible contamination with undeclared almond traces. The recall affects products with best-before dates from Nov. 18 through Nov. 27 and lot codes beginning LD-41 and LD-42, distributed to shops across the Harbour District and neighboring Felton County. No illnesses have been reported, the company said, but customers with almond allergies are being urged not to eat the product and to return it for a full refund. Harbor public health officer Mara Ellin said the recall was “a precautionary step, but an important one for people with severe allergies.”
